scope: Used-seed in-range launch; six correlated lanes, positive normal impulses above 1e-7 Ns, contact samples not independent. Ratio uses static friction and recorded impulse basis. Point velocity combines beginning-of-substep position with the captured candidate velocity and stored world contact point; interpret as estimated only to extent normal, replay and timing checks support it. Near-limit ratio does not prove sliding or a biological friction coefficient. No takeoff or mission qualification.
